limitations: Pure math does not supply current fees, initialized state, price impact across ticks, token transfer behavior, or transaction safety.
All integer operations must preserve the recorded floor/ceil direction; floating-point approximations are display-only.

tickAndPrice.sqrtRatio: sqrtPriceX96 = ceil(sqrt(1.0001^tick) * 2^96) using the deployed TickMath bit-exact algorithm.
tickAndPrice.rawPrice: token1/token0 = sqrtPriceX96^2 / 2^192 as an exact rational.
tickAndPrice.decimalAdjustedDisplay: Multiply the raw token1/token0 ratio by 10^(token0Decimals-token1Decimals). Token ordering and both decimals must be explicit.
tickAndPrice.readBoundary: A slot0 tick anywhere in [-887272, 887272] is representable contract state.
tickAndPrice.writeBoundary: Position ticks must also be strictly ordered and divisible by tickSpacing. For spacing 200 the usable aligned bounds are -887200 and 887200.
tickAndPrice.inverseBoundary: getTickAtSqrtRatio accepts sqrtPriceX96 >= minSqrtRatioX96 and strictly less than maxSqrtRatioX96.

liquidityAmounts.belowRange: All principal is token0; value with [sqrtLower, sqrtUpper].
liquidityAmounts.insideRange: Token0 uses [sqrtCurrent, sqrtUpper] and token1 uses [sqrtLower, sqrtCurrent].
liquidityAmounts.aboveRange: All principal is token1; value with [sqrtLower, sqrtUpper].
liquidityAmounts.liquidityFromBoth: Below/above range use the applicable single-token formula; inside uses min(liquidity0, liquidity1).
liquidityAmounts.roundingBoundary: Position-manager quote math floors received liquidity and principal estimates. Core swap/mint deltas use direction-specific floor or ceil operations; a future writer must match the exact called function rather than reuse a display estimate.

stateBoundaries.uninitializedImplementation: A template implementation may expose zero/default storage and is not a usable initialized pool instance.
stateBoundaries.initializedEmptyPool: A factory-recognized pool may have nonzero initialized sqrtPriceX96 while active liquidity and staked liquidity are zero.
stateBoundaries.zeroLiquidityRead: Zero active liquidity, zero LP supply, or a missing gauge is valid read state and must be represented without division or fabricated APY.
stateBoundaries.partialRead: Preserve each successful field plus an explicit per-field error/unknown when an optional or batched read fails. A partial row is not executable identity and missing values must not be synthesized.
stateBoundaries.staleRow: A row observed at another block or without a same-block factory mapping is analytics evidence only, even when its address and tokens look plausible.
stateBoundaries.strictWriteValidation: A write must reject zero desired liquidity/output, invalid or unaligned ranges, expired deadlines, uninitialized pools, and absent/mismatched dynamic mappings even though those states may be representable in reads.
